title: Guided tour with many interesting facts, without stress, to repeat.
text: To repeat. I learned many curiosities (poor Abencerrajes!), he told the stories patiently and answered my questions. He planned the visit to avoid the most saturated areas when more people go (although the Patio de los Leones always seems to be full, but the Generalife, for example, was almost empty). When I return to Granada I will do one of the other tours, for sure.
author: _O6284OU
